scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the class hooks off vs candidate with the hooks on), 17280 isolated CPU pairs for the 82 functions of CAudioEngine, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored and layout_ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case compares the return value, the trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments, the hash of the fake world and of the saved globals, plus per-function fields; the x87 control word is 24 bits; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Bank limits (AudioEngineFinal4): fake CAudioEngine in own memory (0x1FD8 bytes) and a fake world (opaque entities, finite vectors); every collaborator (CAEAudioHardware, Frontend/Script/Collision/GlobalWeapon/Door/Pedless/PedSpeech/PoliceScanner/Weather entities, radio/cutscene/ambience managers, CAESoundManager, FindPlayerPed and, for Initialise, loading screen, CFileMgr and static initialisers) replaced by traced EntryPatch doubles without credit; real globals saved and restored; masked: embedded-object vtables, tAmbienceSettings padding; out of fixture: mission events above 0xFFFF, radio station ids outside int8. See the bank README for the full list of masked fields and out-of-fixture domains.
